ICS 71.100.70PCD 19Reaffirmed 20241. SCOPE1.1 This standard prescribes the requirements and methods of sampling and test for shaving cream covering both the lather and brushless type.1.2 This standard does not cover all types of aerosols, foams, gels and shaving oilsused for shaving.2.
